title: Han Solo's old trick
description: The Resistance, making use of Finn's intel and Snap Wexley's recon, plotted a high-stakes raid on Starkiller Base, even as the First Order targeted the Resistance base on D'Qar for total annihilation. Sneaking past Starkiller's shields was a significant problem, but Captain Han Solo came up with a clever, if somewhat risky, solution: emerge from hyperspace just above the planet's surface, which is exactly what he managed to do, with the Millennium Falcon skidding to a stop at the edge of a cliff.
